purpose: Compare actual log_perf latencies from the base and PR collectors without changing their timing or allocation policies.
ordering: Alternating arm order across independent process starts; identical seeded shape order and first-weight inputs within each paired replicate.
statistics: Median of seven published latencies within each start, then median across three starts. Keep every sample.
anomaly_checks: Require complete unique keys, finite positive latencies, CUDA graph replay, six timed runs, consistent kernel_source, distinct weight storage and correct publication normalization. Flag samples more than 15% from their within-start median; do not exclude them.
scope: Isolated collector row latency in milliseconds. This is not a model accuracy experiment or a fixed-operation-count graph benchmark.
